item.title: SMB 单位经济
item.summary: 当前证据支持：低摩擦获客闭环最接近者不是单一玩家，而是自助入口低成本获取、快速生产验证、使用扩张和云资源拉动相连接的模式。DigitalOcean、Cloudflare、AWS证明了开发者/团队自助进入与生产价值链；Tencent Buddy AI和Alibaba Cloud OPC证明了AI时代补贴驱动试用和云拉动方向，但持续贡献闭环仍未证实。

synthesis.outlook_12_36m: 未来12—36个月，AI SMB经营判断会从注册数和首月活跃，转向按获客来源核算90/365日留存、持续Token使用、云资源拉动和全成本贡献；最先补齐这些口径的玩家才可能证明闭环。
synthesis.strategic_summary: 当前证据支持：低摩擦获客闭环最接近者不是单一玩家，而是自助入口低成本获取、快速生产验证、使用扩张和云资源拉动相连接的模式。DigitalOcean、Cloudflare、AWS证明了开发者/团队自助进入与生产价值链；Tencent Buddy AI和Alibaba Cloud OPC证明了AI时代补贴驱动试用和云拉动方向，但持续贡献闭环仍未证实。
synthesis.why_now: AI Agent降低了软件生产门槛，但SMB/prosumer商业模式的关键从获取用户转向证明补贴、Token成本、支持成本后的 retained contribution。
winner_conditions: 低摩擦入口能够转化为首次生产
90/365日留存与持续付费同时改善
Token与云资源拉动覆盖模型、基础设施、支持和激励成本
披露小客户 cohort，而不是只披露公司级增长

evidence.source_quote: supporting more than 95% of Tencent engineers and reducing overall coding time by 40%
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Tencent reported CodeBuddy use by more than 95% of its engineers and a 40% reduction in overall coding time.

evidence.source_quote:
未来一年将支持5000家AI原生创新团队
通过Token补贴、专属技术服务、阿里生态场景对接、品牌曝光、融资及创业空间对接等五大维度
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Alibaba Cloud said the OPC program would support 5,000 AI-native teams in one year. | The OPC program includes Token subsidies, dedicated technical service, ecosystem access, brand exposure, financing and workspace support. | The disclosed OPC program terms do not reveal activation, 90/365-day retention, retained ARPU or full contribution after Token subsidies and support.

evidence.source_quote: Excludes revenues, costs and expenses for new AI products (Hy, Yuanbao, CodeBuddy, WorkBuddy, and QClaw)
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Tencent's core operating-profit comparison explicitly excludes revenue, costs and expenses for WorkBuddy and other new AI products.

evidence.source_quote:
60%+ retention rate among active users ➢ 80%+ retention rate among paying users
paying user conversion increases, resulting in rapid growth in token usage on Tencent Cloud in recent weeks
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Tencent's May investor deck reported 60%+ retention among active users and 80%+ among paying users. | Tencent linked more complex agent use and paying conversion to rapid recent token-usage growth on Tencent Cloud.

evidence.source_quote:
198 元 / 人 / 月 78 元/人/月 2,000 Credits/月
首月 将给每个付费 license 额外赠送 2000 Credits 的权益
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Tencent raised the SaaS enterprise seat price from RMB78 to RMB198 per person per month, including 2,000 monthly Credits. | The launch promotion adds 2,000 Credits in the first month for each paid enterprise license.

evidence.source_quote: External revenue growth accelerated even faster, to 40%
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Alibaba reported FY2026 March-quarter Cloud external revenue growth of 40%, with AI-related products at 30% of external revenue.

evidence.source_quote: 80% retention rate among active users2 88% retention rate among paying users2
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Tencent's June investor deck reported next-day retention of 80% among active and 88% among paying CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy users.

evidence.source_quote: Grow with us and make up to a 25% margin when you join the DigitalOcean Partner Pod
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Provides an explicit maximum channel-margin anchor that must be deducted from vendor contribution when a partner serves the account.

evidence.source_quote:
For teams developing and testing with non-production workloads. $24/month
For businesses serving large customer bases with mission-critical applications. Response times within 30 minutes. $999/month
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Paid support steps from $24 to $99 to $999 per month. | The premium tier promises a response within 30 minutes at $999 per month.

evidence.source_quote: Minimum spend $29/month per account
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: AWS Business Support+ has a $29 monthly per-account floor and usage-linked percentage pricing.

evidence.source_quote:
Activate Founders Self-funded Up to $5,000 USD in Activate Credits
Activate Portfolio Pre-Series B Up to $200,000 USD in Activate Credits
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: AWS Activate advertises founder credits up to $5,000 and portfolio credits up to $200,000. | AWS Activate portfolio credits can reach $200,000.

evidence.source_quote: A recent global survey commissioned by Crayon and conducted by Sapio Research found that 94% of IT leaders are struggling to optimize cloud costs.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Commissioned survey signal limits claims that usage pricing is automatically predictable; population is broader than SMB and retained as a reported estimate.

evidence.source_quote: DigitalOcean Droplets are available at a variety of price points, starting from as low as $4 per month.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Droplet entry pricing starts at $4 per month.

evidence.source_quote: This year, AWS SMB Competency Partners grew their SMB AWS business 35% more YoY as compared to a similar group of Partners without SMB Competency.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Vendor-reported comparison supports partner specialization as a growth mechanism but does not provide matched CAC, retention or contribution.

evidence.source_quote:
Net Dollar Retention Rate (“NDR”) increased to 101% from 99% in the fourth quarter of 2024.
Gross profit was $540 million, an increase of 16% year-over-year, and gross profit margin was 60% of revenue.
Beginning in the fourth quarter of 2025, we redefined our total customer count and excluded the number of users that spend less than or equal to $500 in a month
The number of $100K+ Customers (2) grew 26%, while the revenue from these customers, which now represents 28% of total revenue
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: DigitalOcean reported Q4 2025 company-level NDR of 101%, up from 99%. | DigitalOcean reported FY2025 gross margin of 60%. | DigitalOcean redefined its customer count to exclude users spending $500 or less per month. | Customers above $100K represented 28% of Q4 revenue.

evidence.source_quote: The current annual price for the Partner Success Core Benefits program is $925 USD or its equivalent in local currency.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Prices a partner enablement package that includes five technical pre-sales/deployment hours and two cloud-support incidents, revealing a bounded service unit.

evidence.source_quote: By migrating some of its classifiers to Amazon SageMaker Serverless Inference, Forethought saved around 80 percent on related cloud costs.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Forethought reported up to 80% lower cost on selected classifiers using SageMaker Serverless Inference.

evidence.source_quote: Many products include a free tier or included usage — you are only charged for usage that exceeds the included amount.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Many usage-priced products include free or included usage and charge only above it.

evidence.source_quote:
GAAP gross profit was $1,615.4 million, or 74.5% gross margin
we closed our largest annual contract value deal ever—averaging $42.5 million per year
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: Cloudflare reported FY2025 GAAP gross margin of 74.5%. | Cloudflare highlighted a largest annual contract averaging $42.5 million a year.

evidence.source_quote: If we were to use AWS for everything, our costs would be around $55,000 more per month than they are with DigitalOcean.
evidence.theme_relevance_reason: RouteTrust reported roughly $55,000 lower monthly cost than using AWS for everything.
